title: Pit Firing Workshop
source_quote:
Pit Firing Workshop
Learn traditional pit firing techniques in this six hour hands-on session. Natural and inorganic materials paint the smooth surface of bisque fired pieces with vibrant color in this fire kissed process. Bring your own narrower bisque fired pots or purchase pieces previously made at Little Creek Studios.
$175
Sign Up
evidence_sentence: The workshops page describes a six-hour pit firing workshop teaching traditional techniques with natural and inorganic materials.
evidence_quote: Learn traditional pit firing techniques in this six hour hands-on session.
summary: Six-hour pit firing workshop where you bring your own bisque-fired pots (or buy pieces made at the studio) to fire with natural and inorganic materials. Cost is $175.
